listingImageSync.title: Listing images
listingImageSync.description: Check daily for Amazon US listings created in this system at least 7 days ago. Recheck 7 days after the last successful check. Upload changed MAIN images to Cloudinary; keep manually edited images.
listingImageSync.upgrade: Update and reload the extension to enable listing image sync.
listingImageSync.offline: Extension is offline. Jobs resume when the extension reconnects.
listingImageSync.confirm: Check all existing Amazon US listings in this shop now, including listings less than 7 days old and recently checked listings. Manually edited images remain protected. This may take several hours for large catalogs.
